description:
Top-10 contractors

The ten contractors that won the most in one province or sector (tenders), in one province by direct procurement (`direct`), or the ten firms based in a province with the most public-contract revenue anywhere (`headquartered`). Legal names as recorded in EKAP; no tax numbers.

GET /v1/public-procurement/top-contractors on Public procurement statistics (SBX-IHALE). Costs 1 credit per call.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, with the same filters.

province.description: A province's plate code or name. Give this or `sector`.

sector.description: A sector id or name. Give this or `province`.
